findings.reason: a queue dispatching s12 and s13 as the declared waits permit admits two nodes into `promotion_records.py` at once, which the one-writer-per-file rule forbids, and the fix is a declared wait (or a split write path) the worker cannot invent for itself.
findings.text: §13's write scope includes "the manifest checker module that validates `baseline_suite`", which is `reckon/crew/promotion_records.py` (the arm validation at lines 778–790, through `ledger.suite_observation_missing_fields`), the file §12 declares as its own write path; `plan-section-depends-on` gives s13 only `s11`, and f-aprteig-011's body orders "§13 runs after §11", so nothing the plan declares keeps the two sections out of one file at the same time

findings.reason: an exclusive write scope that names no path is unenforceable, and the guess decides whether the node edits one file or two.
findings.text: §13's third write path is a description, "the manifest checker module that validates `baseline_suite`", not a file: the arm validation it points at is `reckon/crew/promotion_records.py` lines 778–790, so a worker holding that write scope can open nothing from the plan and must guess whether the field is accepted at the parse in `reckon/crew/reports.py` or at the arm check in `promotion_records.py`

findings.reason: §7 already settled that one log has two identities to compare against, so a worker implementing §13 as written re-creates the wrong-base comparison for every digest-carrying gate; the plan must either match on both identities or refuse when no pair matches and the gate is not the default.
findings.text: §13 matches a gate to its pair by "the pair whose head arm's log is the gate log" and falls back to the default pair when none matches, but a gate check may carry a digest instead of a path (`_default_gate_evidence_from_manifest`, `reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:345–347`, treats `log_path` or `log_digest` as the given evidence), and a suite arm may record `log_digest` rather than `log_path` (`reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:1177`); a digest-named gate therefore matches no pair, falls back to `baseline_suite`, and is judged against the wrong base — the exact defect §13 exists to remove — with no refusal to say so
